result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on what platform you're using. If you're selling in Canada, there are a few particularly good options.

Here's how I'd rank them.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Excellent for small and growing online businesses.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- Accepts credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- No standard monthly processing subscription.
- Good reporting and fraud prevention tools.

Website: [Stripe Canada](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout experience.
- Supports major credit cards and digital wallets.
- Simplifies refunds, reporting and payment management.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Widely recognized by online shoppers.
- Customers can pay using PayPal or eligible cards.
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms.
- Good as an additional checkout option.

Website: [PayPal Business Canada](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Combines online payments and point-of-sale transactions.
- Easy inventory and sales management.

Website: [Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Canadian payment processing company.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- Worth considering as transaction volume increases.
- Particularly interesting for businesses processing higher sales volumes.

Website: [Helcim](https://www.helcim.com/)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store in Canada\:

| Situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Custom-built website | Stripe |
| Online and physical sales | Square |
| Higher transaction volume | Helcim |
| Additional payment option | PayPal |


I'd start with one primary processor and add PayPal as an alternative checkout option if customers want it.
